status.nb: 105 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 15 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Islamabad, Peshawar og Kabul.

summary.en: Security forces killed cross-border infiltrators in Upper Kurram and arrested Afghan Taliban members in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. A bomb disposal official was killed by an IED in Upper South Waziristan. A bus-truck collision on the Hazara Motorway killed eight and injured thirty, while separate crashes in Abbottabad and Bhakkar killed eleven and injured thirty-three. TTP wanted commander Abu Dujana Khyberi was among five killed in operations in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. 1,794 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Sikkerhetsstyrker drepte grensekrypende infiltratører i Upper Kurram og arresterte medlemmer av Afghan Taliban i Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. En sprengningsansvarlig ble drept av en IED i Upper South Waziristan. En buss-lastebil-kollisjon på Hazara-motorveien drepte åtte og såret tretti, mens separate ulykker i Abbottabad og Bhakkar drepte elleve og såret tretti-tre. TTP-ønsket kommandør Abu Dujana Khyberi var blant fem som ble drept i operasjoner i Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. 1 794 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
